Draft.description: Saved draft metadata; one per (item, editor), and never a revision.

base_revision.description: Head revision the draft is based on; a Snapshot conflicts if the item changed since.

content_digest.description:
Digest of the drafted body and every property but the server-owned header, `aliases`
included, keys sorted. Unlike `ItemDocument::content_digest`, any edit changes it, one to
`aliases` alone included: it tells whether a draft is still the content a Snapshot
committed.

editor.description: Server-established subject who owns this draft.

item.description: The item as it is at `revision`; absent when the item does not exist there.

ExtractionStatus.description: The converter's verdict on one source, as a listing and a filter use it.

oneOf.description: Every page, or the whole non-paginated document, was converted.
A document was produced but part of the source is missing from it.
The converter produced no document; the bytes are retained.
No converter exists for this format; the bytes are retained.

ExtractionSummary.description: What a listing shows about one source.

corrected.description: A human correction is shown over that text.

ItemId.description: Stable item identity independent of its current relative path.

ItemKind.description: Built-in presentation roles; user-defined OKF type names remain unrestricted.

oneOf.description: An appearance of immutable source bytes.

ItemStatus.description:
OKF's `status` word of an item, distinct from business approval and from archiving.

An absent OKF `status` reads `stable`. `other` is a producer's value outside the three,
kept exactly as written in the file's `status` property; it cannot be set through
`set_lifecycle`.

oneOf.description: A status word outside the three, preserved in the file.

ItemSummary.description: A navigable item description bound to a resolved workspace revision.

archived.description: Hidden from ordinary current listings; reversible and keeps history.

extraction.description: The converter's verdict and whose text is shown; present exactly when `kind` is `source`.

media_type.description: Original MIME type if there is a source object.

type_name.description: User-selected OKF type; not a closed enum.

TextOrigin.description: Whose text a source card shows and search indexes.

oneOf.description: Text an agent proposed and a person accepted.
No text: pending, failed or unsupported, with nothing supplied.

WorkspacePath.description: A relative path inside one workspace, in Unicode NFC, with `/` between segments. At most 4096 bytes in UTF-8: a character takes one to four.

description: The caller's drafts, without other editors' drafts, each with its item's summary.

items.description: The drafts, most recently saved first.

revision.description: The head at which the items were read.

title: ListDraftsResponse
